*FAIR WARNING. It's not the cleanest recording. I coughed a few times, and I had to record this one at home and the neighbor's dog is barking at points in the background! I needed audio for my own students the next day, so there wasn't time to clean up the audio. I keep thinking I'll re-record in my quiet room...but stuff keeps coming up. I'm rather amused by the passionate feelings listeners have had about all of this. My students are stunned that anyone would WILLINGLY listen to my voice. Other than that, enjoy the story...?
